_about: Plan 2026-11-05d Phase 0: what a careful reader writes for each document. Each entry is [topic, applies_to, strength, says, quote]; a quote is the document's own words. The direction-bible is the plan's example (13 entries); the phone-call notes are synthetic; the third file is the real 3-episode drama.
